sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)

Commencing Alpha Route — welfare check along Starbucks, all clear; patrolling down Queen Street with welfare checks along the way.
Response call from McDonald's Queen: female customer asleep inside the lobby for over an hour (she had bought food earlier).
Arrived; successfully moved the sleeping POI along without further complaints. Attempted to capture on bodycam but it took too long to turn on — no footage of the removal.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience store and Mid City shopping centre, all clear. Standby to show presence.
Welfare check on Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square; full sweep, no issues. Standby for response calls.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Queen and Wellesley Street, no issues. Patrolling down Queen St showing presence.
Arrived at corner of Queen and Wyndham Street; area checked, no issues.
Arrived at corner of Queen and Shortland Street, all clear.
Scoped Pocket Park for problematic vagrants, all clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; floor checks on lower ground and level 1, all clear.
Welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, no issues. Arrived at Commercial Bay; full sweep and welfare checks on stores, all clear.
Welfare check at the end of Queens Wharf waterfront, all clear.
Welfare check on OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Welfare check on Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, no issues. Ending Alpha Route.
Arrived at corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection; location checked, all clear.
Welfare check along 17th Albert Street stores, all clear.
Welfare check within Federal Square and The Cathedral Church; walkthrough completed, no vagrants or problems.
Welfare check inside Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Cafe and Barclay's Suites, all clear.
Welfare check on Little Albert's Cafe and The People's Barista, all clear.
Arrived at Top of Victoria Street; welfare checks along all stores. Standby to show presence — street vagrants visible.
Welfare checks completed along stores within Federal Street.
Arrived at corner of Federal and Wellesley Street, no issues.
Welfare check on Star Convenience store, all clear.
Arrived at Top of Mayoral Drive; full scope and quick checks on stores, no issues.
Welfare check on Airedale Suites, all clear.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, no issues.
Arrived at Elliott Street apartment, all clear. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott and the Food Court, no issues.
Welfare check along Strand Arcade, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Queen and Victoria Street; camera/news crew visible, possibly broadcasting the new statue. Standby to show presence.
Heading up to HQ for quick morning interval.
Morning interval concluded. Ending Charlie Route.
Patrolling down Queen Street showing presence and scoping the area for vagrants to be moved along.
Welfare check along Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough, checked into stores and static guards, all clear.
Welfare check back on OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Welfare check on Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths; no reports from static guard.
Arrived at Kiwi Bank; welfare check on static guards and nearby stores, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, cleared of issues.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street; checked into all stores and cafes, no trouble reported. Standby for presence and response calls.

Arrived at Wilson's Carpark; area scoped. Vape Haven reported a male individual (wearing blue) who comes every morning to harass the employee — behaviour ongoing for several days. Photo retrieved and posted to Auror; the POI smokes and teasingly dances in front of the store, puffing smoke inside (photo on file). No other reports. Standby in case the POI returns.
Continuing patrols — POI not visible; notified Vape Haven to contact us immediately if seen.
Welfare check along Lower High Street and O'Connell Lane, all clear.
Welfare check and walkthrough along Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square; full sweep, checked into stores, all clear.
Continuing patrols; more checks along Upper High Street.
Welfare checks along Lorne Street stores and businesses; no issues along the water fountain.
Arrived at corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street; scoped, all clear. Heading back to HQ for lunch break.
Arrived at HQ; taking break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Response call from Dangerfield outlet: female being rude towards staff and causing a disturbance.

Arrived; manager identified the POI. Informed her she had to leave due to her behaviour towards staff; she complied and left. Standby outside — female still outside and threatening to return and start a protest.
Female POI departed; informed managers she had moved along and to call back if she returns.
Maintaining presence on Lower Queen St for nearby response calls, with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare checks on Lower Queen St all clear. Commencing Alpha Route; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay complete, all clear.
Arrived at Lower Albert St; welfare checks on stores, all clear.
Arrived at Albert St; welfare check on Albert Mart and Remarkable Gifts, all clear.
Arrived at corner of Albert St / Victoria St West; welfare checks on stores complete, all clear.
Aotea Square sweep complete, no issues. Ending Alpha Route; commencing Beta Route.
Arrived outside Avachi Chicken; welfare check on stores on Upper Queen St, all clear. Standby for issues and nearby response calls.
Arrived at High St check-in; commencing full sweep down to Shortland St with welfare checks:
Arrived at Shortland St; welfare checks along High St and full sweep of Chancery/Freyberg Square complete, no issues.
Arrived at Fort St; commencing full sweep down to Gore St with welfare checks.
Arrived at Gore St (outside Giapo); welfare checks and full sweep complete:
Arrived at Commercial Bay; standby for issues/vagrants.
Leaving standby, heading back up Queen St.
Arrived at Darby St check-in; welfare check:
Arrived at Elliott Stables; welfare check, all clear. Standby.
Heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Response call from Star Kebab: female being a disturbance inside the store; assistance requested to remove her.
Arrived; POI had already left, heading towards Karangahape Road. Standby in case she returns.
Heading back to HQ to charge phone (low).
Commencing patrols down to Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, no issues.
Arrived at top of Victoria St; welfare checks on stores still open, all clear.
Arrived at Wellesley St West; showing presence at a Heart of the City event at Te Waihorotiu train station.
Response call from McDonald's Queen St: male being a disturbance inside; assistance requested to remove him.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen St; informed the male to leave per manager's orders, he complied and left. Also received a response call from Soy Hotel: male outside being disruptive and kicking their windows; assistance requested.
Arrived at Soy Hotel; POI had already left. Description: black hat, blue jeans, red t-shirt, black beanie; last seen heading down Beach Road. Standby.
Heading back to HQ for 30-minute meal break.
Arrived at HQ for meal break.
Standby at HQ awaiting night shift, alert to response calls.
Afternoon shift complete. Auror reports have been made.
Equipment handover: 5x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
